name: La Casa del Árbol de las Familias
summary:
Welcome to La Casa del Árbol de las Familias, an educational VR experience from Academus Digital.

Visit three rooms about family diversity, teamwork, and family history and affection. Discover different families, help with everyday tasks, and explore memories through nine illustrated activities. Complete each room to earn a heart and reach the final celebration.

Five videos and 44 spoken prompts in Mexican Spanish accompany the journey. Large buttons, simple words and picture-based guidance help children
